## Description {#details}

<p>Add CF_ALU.</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/r600">R600</a> Alu instructions are grouped in clause which can hold 128 Alu instructions ; these instructions can access up to 4 prefetched 4 lines of 16 registers from constant buffers. Such ALU clauses are initiated by CF_ALU instructions.</p>
